title: Legal Forms and Strategies
subtitle: Dr. Mamouni & Dr. Ibrahimi are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! ⚖️

Dr. Mamouni and Dr. Ibrahimi are two passionate dentists. Their practices are thriving, but a crucial question remains: what legal form should they choose to protect their assets and optimize their taxes?

Between sole proprietorship, LLC, single-member LLC, SELARL... the choices are numerous and each has its consequences.

A wrong choice, and it's the family heritage that is exposed. 💸

Their assets, their family, their peace of mind rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Mamouni and Dr. Ibrahimi are two passionate dentists. Their practices are thriving, but a crucial question remains: what legal form should they choose? They discover the basics: sole proprietorship, LLC, single-member LLC.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Mamouni and Dr. Ibrahimi deepen their knowledge of legal forms. They study the 2024 amendments to Law 5-96, governance, and transmission mechanisms.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Mamouni and Dr. Ibrahimi face strategic choices: sole proprietorship vs LLC, protection of personal assets, tax optimization. They must choose the structure adapted to their situation.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Mamouni and Dr. Ibrahimi manage complex legal situations: succession, transfer of shares, conflict between partners, governance. They master the legal tools.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Mamouni and Dr. Ibrahimi become legal strategy references. They train young dentists in the choice of legal forms and asset protection.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and commitment, Dr. Mamouni and Dr. Ibrahimi pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of legal skills and excellence to the dental profession.
